1. Enable Developer Options: Settings → About Phone → Tap Build Number 7 times.

2. Inside Developer Options, find "Select mock location app" and choose NotreMock.

3. Grant Location permission (required by Android 14+ to run a location service) and disable Battery Optimization so Android does not kill the service.

4. Pick any city on Home and tap Start. You can use any VPN (V2Ray, WireGuard, etc.) at the same time—NotreMock never occupies Android's VPN slot.

• Use a VPN whose exit country matches your mocked city.

• Turn OFF Wi-Fi Scanning & Bluetooth Scanning in Location Settings so apps cannot infer your location from nearby routers.

• Turn OFF Automatic TimeZone and set the city's TimeZone (or use Shizuku for 1-tap automatic sync).

• For maximum privacy on non-root phones: enable Airplane Mode + Wi-Fi so cellular towers and SIM MCC/MNC cannot leak your region.

• Add Quick Settings Tile ("NotreMock GPS") to your top shade for an instant Kill Switch.

Standard Android (No Root):
• Mock GPS works system-wide with zero VPN conflict.
• Auto-Pause temporarily restores real GPS when you open bypassed foreground apps (Neshan, Balad, Maps).
• Android blocks non-root apps from hiding SIM info from other apps or excluding background services like Find My Device simultaneously.

Shizuku (No Root, Wireless Debugging):
• Unlocks automatic system TimeZone switching.

Root + LSPosed:
• Unlocks true simultaneous per-app bypass (including Find My Device), SIM/MCC/Cell spoofing, per-app TimeZone, and hiding the isMock() flag.

NotreMock is a minimal, privacy-first, open-source Mock Location utility.

• Zero telemetry, zero ads, offline-first by design.
• Pre-loaded with ~2,680+ world capitals & provincial capitals.
• Supports English & Persian (RTL).
